title: Reliable Helper
description: The Snezhnayan merchant Tsarevich is looking for a dependable person to help him resolve a few problems.

mainQuestExcel.title: Reliable Helper
mainQuestExcel.description: The Snezhnayan merchant Tsarevich is looking for a dependable person to help him resolve a few problems.

dialogs.text: What awful luck. These Knights of Favonius are really...
Is something wrong?
Hmph! These Knights of Favonius have no sense of efficiency at all. They said that there were monsters ahead, and wouldn't let me pass.
But even now, I still haven't received anything more concrete from them. What an unreliable lot...
I still have so many matters to attend to. Do they have any idea how much money they're costing me?
Still... Well, you look like an adventurer, don't you? How about this — would you be willing to do a little something for me? I'll pay you.
Leave it to me.
Wonderful. I love straightforward people. You will be well rewarded once the deed is done, I guarantee it.
Perhaps my eyes deceive me, but the hilichurls around Mondstadt seem to have grown more numerous. Who knows what these so-called Knights are doing all day?
Since you've agreed to aid me, then you can help to drive them off for me. Yet, you are only one person. Hmm...
Forget it. Pick one of these areas to clean out yourself: the peak, side or foot of the mountain.
It's all hilichurls no matter where you go, so there's no difference. Now go, and don't waste my time.
How much are you offering?
Hah, that will depend on the manner of your deeds. If you do well, I will see to it that you are well rewarded.
Why are you still here? Get over there! It's just a bunch of hilichurls, how long do you plan to dilly-dally?

flow.stepDescription: Defeat the Hilichurls as requested by Tsarevich

dialogs.text: Done and dusted.
So soon? In less than a minute, even! You're quite good. Quite good indeed, hahaha!
Good, good. 5,000 Mora, and not one Mora less. Take it.
"Quite good," and all we get is 5,000 Mora...
Don't you get picky, now. I calculated this remuneration very carefully, and it is commensurate with the work.
One must do great things to earn great rewards. If we have the chance to meet again, you can try your luck then.
That's a wrap.
Dragging your feet, just like the Knights of Favonius. I gave you a minute! Did you forget, or did you not listen in the first place?
No attention paid, even to such simple details... 1,000 Mora it is. Do with it what you will.
1,000 Mora? So little!?
How much do you expect for a job done like that? This is the pay you deserve — now take it!
Why are you still here? Get over there! It's just a bunch of hilichurls, how long do you plan to dilly-dally?
So. Have you done as I asked?

flow.stepDescription: Defeat the Hilichurls as requested by Tsarevich

dialogs.text: Of course.
Not bad, not bad. Not a box was damaged, either — you know what you're doing.
Here, take this 5,000 Mora. If the opportunity comes, let us do business again.
All that work, just for 5,000 Mora...
Don't you get picky, now. I calculated this remuneration very carefully, and it is commensurate with the work.
One must do great things to earn great rewards. If we have the chance to meet again, you can try your luck then.
It's done.
Did you mishear me, or are you hoping that I'll let this slide? Huh?
I told you not to break those boxes, and you broke this many? Can they even be sold at this point?
I didn't see any goods...
It was those boxes! Those were my goods! Why do you think I would stack them up outside anyway otherwise?
Forget it. Forget it! I have nothing to say to attention-deficient louts like you. Here's 1,000 Mora — take it and be off!
1,000 Mora? That's way too little!
Too little? You can't even do a simple job right, and you want more money? This is the amount you deserve!
So. Have you done as I asked?
Don't touch those boxes however you like. If they break, I can't sell them.
They aren't worth a lot, but I still bought them with Mora — they didn't just drop from the sky into my lap.

flow.stepDescription: Defeat the Hilichurls as requested by Tsarevich

dialogs.text: So. Have you done as I asked?
What misfortune. The road is impassable, my goods can't be moved, and I can't even take a good walk.
What in the world do the Knights do with their time, anyway?
Hmph. If this was Snezhnaya...
I'll take the foot of the mountains.
The foot, is it? There's not much down there, just a bunch of hilichurls. They're not much of a threat, but they are an eyesore.
Go and take care of them all. For such a simple task, I'll give you... one minute. That should be enough.
I'll head for the mountainside.
Ah, there's some cargo of mine that I had intended to transport back and sell on the mountainside.
But now, not only have the roads been blocked, but the area where I stored my cargo has also been occupied by hilichurls.
Fortunately, they don't have a good eye for value, and didn't touch my goods.
Now go and clear them out, and remember not to touch my cargo. Those boxes break easily.
*sigh* With these roads being blocked, those goods probably can't be sold anymore...
I'll go for the mountaintop.
The group of hilichurls on the mountaintop are the hardest to deal with. I used to go there to relax, but now I dare not even venture close. Very unfortunate.
Well, you look quite capable, so I suppose it'll be a fitting task for you.
Remember, that big blockhead with the axe has to go first. Watching him walk around all full of himself just makes my blood boil.
Then there's the one that waves its big shield around in your face. What an eyesore...
Finally, you want to take out those with the long staves... What do they call them, again? Samachurls? Either way, they don't look so tough...
In any case, get rid of them all. Get them out of my sight.
That's a wrap.
Not... Not bad at all, you...
Forget it, I'll say nothing more. Take this 5,000 Mora. We Snezhnayan merchants always deliver as promised.
So Snezhnayan merchants only deliver 5,000 Mora, huh...
Don't you get picky, now. I calculated this remuneration very carefully, and it is commensurate with the work.
One must do great things to earn great rewards. If we have the chance to meet again, you can try your luck then.
It's done.
...I watched you work from the side, you know.
But are you just used to doing things at your own pace, or did you not pay any heed to the order I gave you at all?
Do you know? In Snezhnaya, we say that we "deliver as promised."
I pay you to do things for me, and every word that I say has meaning.
You did complete the task, but these results... I can only give you 1,000 Mora at most. Take it and go.
What? 1,000 Mora? What can we even use that for?
Hmph. Too little, you say? You didn't even do the job right. This 1,000 Mora is more than sufficient.
That's a wrap.
